market_context.benchmark_filter: Benchmark (SPY or QQQ) must be above its 50-day SMA for any bullish bias. If below, default all stocks to neutral or bearish.

bias_criteria_note: bearish criteria = exit/avoid signal on longs ONLY. Not short entries. Short-side trades require a separate MOMENTUM-SHORT screener (future work).

bullish: Stock is printing higher highs and higher lows on the daily
Trendlines with Breaks [LuxAlgo] shows a recent bullish B (breakout) signal
Breakout candle volume is significantly higher than the prior 5-10 day average
Price is approaching or at the upper Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band but NOT extended outside it
High Relative Volume (RVOL) — stock has a clear catalyst (earnings, news, sector rotation)
bearish: Stock is printing lower highs and lower lows on the daily
Trendlines with Breaks [LuxAlgo] shows a recent bearish breakdown signal
Price has broken back below a prior breakout trendline on volume
Price is extended outside the lower Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band
neutral: Stock is consolidating — no clear higher highs/lows pattern
No breakout signal from Trendlines with Breaks [LuxAlgo]
Price is chopping inside the Nadaraya-Watson Envelope bands
Volume is average or below average — no clear catalyst present

long: Stock consolidating near local highs (flag, pennant, or horizontal resistance)
Trendlines with Breaks [LuxAlgo] prints bullish B signal above upper trendline
Breakout candle volume significantly above 5-10 day average
Price breaking toward upper Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band but NOT fully outside it

exit_criteria.stop_loss: Below breakout candle low or nearest prior swing low. Exit immediately if price closes back below the broken trendline (failed breakout).
exit_criteria.take_profit_1: Scale out 1/2 to 1/3 of position when price touches or pierces upper Nadaraya-Watson Envelope band — signals short-term exhaustion.
exit_criteria.take_profit_2: Trail remaining position — exit if price closes below previous day's low, or use 9 EMA as trailing stop after scaling out.

risk_rules: Minimum R:R of 1:2 before entering any trade
Only trade stocks with a clear catalyst (earnings, news, sector rotation)
Stock must be capable of a 5-10% move — avoid low-volatility names
No bullish entries if SPY or QQQ is below its 50-day SMA
Exit immediately on a failed breakout — price closes back below the broken trendline
Maximum 3 open momentum stock positions at once
asset_notes: Momentum stocks on the daily timeframe. Breakouts must be confirmed by volume — a breakout without volume is a trap. The Nadaraya-Watson Envelope prevents buying overextended moves. Institutional buying is the key signal — daily trendline breaks on high volume indicate smart money entry.
